query.text: 请协助我安全行走，发现障碍或危险时提醒我，绕过障碍或危险解除时告诉我。
query.text_en: Please help me walk safely. Alert me to obstacles or hazards, and tell me when I have passed an obstacle or a hazard has cleared.

annotation.text_en: A motorcycle is blocking the tactile paving.

annotation.text_en: A street sign and scooter are blocking the tactile paving ahead.
